title: nan
authors: Leichtfried M.; Kaltenriner C.; Mossel A.; Kaufmann H.
key_contribution: Presents a low-cost UAV using a smartphone as the onboard processing unit for mapping, localization, and navigation in GPS-denied indoor environments, with demonstrated experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
